summary: Offensive spam/phishing/credential-abuse toolkit operated by the installer
details: monogrok is a heavily obfuscated (obfuscator.io) offensive toolkit whose modules implement bulk mail-bombing, SMTP credential harvesting against AWS SES / SendGrid / Mailgun / Postmark endpoints (func/smx/{aws,sendgrid,awssho,sgsho,awsxt,sgxt,crdv,passgo}), IMAP/POP3/EWS/webmail credential checkers (func/box/{imap,pop3,ewsv,msap,ckie,cnfg}), phishing HTML/RTF/XLSX generators (func/gtp/{encryptHtml,cHtmlRtf,cHtmlXls}), a redirect/OAST engine, and Discord webhook result reporting (_init/props/.smtp/resulthook.txt references https://discord.com/api/webhooks/...). All 200+ command and helper files are wrapped by the same obfuscator (shared symbol _0x2c469c across the tree) behind a license/login gate. The package is designed to be operated by the installer against third-party mail providers and their end users; the installer configures all destinations (Shodan key, Discord webhook, target lists). No code path in the traced files exfiltrates the installer's credentials, reads installer secret paths (~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc), drops attacker-controlled binaries at install time, or opens a backdoor against the installer machine. The obfuscation is consistent with anti-tampering / license enforcement of a commercial abuse tool, not with hiding an installer-side payload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
